d: ⚔️ ผู้พัฒนาเกมอินดี้แก้ท่าวิ่งตามคำติ พอปรับให้เท่ขึ้น ผู้เล่นกลับบอกแบบเดิมมีเสน่ห์กว่าซะงั้น! . Ouloboros Studio ผู้พัฒนา SaviorS: Oath of the Blade กำลังพิจารณานำท่าวิ่งทั้งแบบเก่าและใหม่มาใช้ หลังปรับแอนิเมชันตามคำติว่า “ดูไม่เป็นธรรมชาติ” แต่กลับมีผู้เล่นจำนวนมากบอกว่าแบบเดิมมีเสน่ห์กว่า . เรื่องเริ่มจากคลิปบน X ที่เปรียบเทียบท่าวิ่งถือดาบของตัวเอกหญิง แบบเดิมยกดาบไว้ด้านหลังหัวไหล่ ท่าทางดูเก้ ๆ กัง ๆ แต่น่ารัก ส่วนแบบใหม่ลดดาบชี้ลงและโน้มตัวไปข้างหน้า ให้ความรู้สึกคล่องแคล่วและเท่ขึ้น . เสียงตอบรับจึงแบ่งเป็นสองฝั่งค่อนข้างสูสี บางคนชอบท่าใหม่ที่ดูเหมาะกับนักดาบหญิงในโลกแฟนตาซี ขณะที่อีกหลายคนมองว่าท่าเดิมมีเอกลักษณ์ ดูน่าเอ็นดู และสื่อถึงนักผจญภัยมือใหม่ได้ดี จนไม่อยากให้เสน่ห์ตรงนี้หายไป . ทีมพัฒนามองว่าทั้งสองแบบมีจุดเด่น จึงกำลังคิดถึงระบบที่ให้ท่าถือดาบและท่าวิ่งเปลี่ยนตามการเติบโตของตัวละคร ผู้เล่นจะได้เห็นการเคลื่อนไหวค่อย ๆ ชำนาญขึ้นเมื่อผ่านการต่อสู้และออกผจญภัยมากขึ้น แต่แนวทางนี้ยังอยู่ระหว่างพิจารณา . SaviorS: Oath of the Blade เป็นเกมแอ็กชัน RPG แนว Roguelite ภาพพิกเซล โดยมีกำหนดวางจำหน่ายบน PC ผ่าน Steam ในปี 2027 . แล้วเพื่อน ๆ ล่ะ ชอบท่าวิ่งแบบไหนมากกว่ากัน ระหว่างแบบเดิมที่ดูเก้ ๆ กัง ๆ แต่น่ารัก กับแบบใหม่ที่ดูคล่องแคล่วและเท่ขึ้น? #techcatchup #SaviorS #OuloborosStudio #เทรนด์วันนี้

d: 🥊 จากแก๊งโตเกียวมันจิไค สู่สังเวียน FATAL FURY! ไมกี้–ดราเคนข้ามโลกมาท้าต่อยแล้ว . SNK วางขาย FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves บน Nintendo Switch 2 ที่เล่นได้ทั้งพกพา ตั้งโต๊ะ และต่อทีวี เลือกบังคับแบบ Smart Style เพื่อกดท่าพิเศษกับคอมโบได้ง่ายขึ้น หรือใช้ Arcade Style กดคำสั่งเองแบบดั้งเดิม . 🎮 Standard Edition มีเฉพาะเกมหลัก ราคา 19.99 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ (ประมาณ 670 บาท) ส่วน Starter Edition รวมเกมและ Season Pass 1–3 ราคา 29.99 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ (ประมาณ 1,010 บาท) ซื้อดิจิทัลได้ทาง Nintendo eShop แล้ว ส่วน Starter Edition แบบแผ่นจะขาย 21 มกราคม 2027 . Mai Shiranui กลับมาในชุดนินจาหญิง ส่วน Terry Bogard กลับมาใส่หมวกกับเสื้อกั๊กสีแดง ขายชุดละ 2.99 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ (ประมาณ 100 บาท) ชุดไมซื้อได้แล้วบน PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S และ PC ส่วน Switch 2 มีแถมให้ผู้จองดิจิทัล และจะแถมกับแผ่นเกมช่วงแรก ก่อนขายแยกภายหลัง . 👊 ไมกี้กับดราเคนจาก Tokyo Revengers เข้าร่วม Season Pass 3 พร้อมท่าต่อสู้ที่เข้ากับบุคลิกและนักพากย์ญี่ปุ่นดั้งเดิม ทั้งคู่มีเนื้อเรื่องใหม่ในโหมด Arcade และร่วมมือกันช่วย Rock จาก Krauser ในโหมด RPG เล่นคนเดียว EOST . Season Pass 3 ราคา 19.99 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ (ประมาณ 670 บาท) รวม Rick Strowd, Duck King, Kim Kaphwan และสองหนุ่มจาก Tokyo Revengers ส่วน Laocorn จะตามมาเดือนพฤศจิกายน และ Reina เดือนธันวาคม 2026 . ฝั่ง PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S และ PC มี Legend Edition รวมพาส 1–2 ราคา 39.99 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ (ประมาณ 1,350 บาท) กับ Revenge Edition รวมพาส 1–3 ราคา 49.99 ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ (ประมาณ 1,690 บาท) . ตัวเกมใช้ REV System รองรับออนไลน์ข้ามแพลตฟอร์มพร้อม rollback netcode ช่วยลดผลจากความหน่วง ส่วนแฟนอนิเมะก็ดู Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc ผ่าน Disney+ ได้แล้ว . การมีเรื่องราวใหม่ให้ติดตามกันปูทางให้ไมกี้กับดราเคนมีที่มาที่ไปในโลกของ Fatal Fury ส่วนแฟนเก่าก็ได้กลับมาเล่นไมกับเทอร์รี่ในชุดที่คุ้นเคย พร้อมระบบต่อสู้ของภาคใหม่ . อัปเดตนี้แฟน ๆ Tokyo Revengers ถูกใจกันไหม? . อ่านฉบับเต็มบนเว็บไซต์ 🌐 . #techcatchup #FatalFuryCotW #NintendoSwitch2 #TokyoRevengers
zh: 《东京复仇者》万次郎、龙宫寺坚参战《饿狼传说：狼之城》，登陆Switch 2

Antes de ir a clases trabaja, corre contra el tiempo y carga con responsabilidades que nadie en el prestigioso Instituto Haneul podría imaginar. Kang Hyuk, en cambio, ha crecido rodeado de lujos y privilegios. Es heredero de una de las familias más poderosas de Corea y está acostumbrado a una vida en la que prácticamente todo parece estar a su alcance. Esta mañana comienza como cualquier otra para ambos… sin saber que están a punto de llegar al mismo lugar. Dos vidas. Dos mundos completamente distintos. Y un encuentro que todavía no saben cuánto podrá cambiarlo todo. 💗 Así comienza Nuestro Propio Mundo. 🎬 Capítulo 1 ✨ Una historia original estilo K-drama 📺 Capítulos completos en Facebook y YouTube #NuestroPropioMundo #KDrama #DramaCoreano #KDramaEnEspañol #RomanceCoreano

d: 🇰🇷 NUESTRO PROPIO MUNDO | Episodio 3 Algo empieza a cambiar entre ellos… Todo comenzó con una pregunta aparentemente inocente: «¿A qué hora sales?» Pero cuando Min-ji termina su turno y descubre que Hyuk todavía está afuera de la cafetería, empieza a sospechar que quizá no estaba preguntando por simple curiosidad. Hyuk intenta disimular diciendo que «solo iba hacia allá» y ambos terminan caminando juntos por las calles de Seúl. Cuando su chofer finalmente lo encuentra, Hyuk le ofrece llevarla a casa en su automóvil, pero Min-ji, fiel a su manera independiente de ser, rechaza la propuesta y continúa hacia la parada del autobús. Lo que ella jamás imaginó fue que Hyuk dejaría atrás su lujoso automóvil para subir al autobús con ella. 😳❤️ Dentro, Min-ji descubre algo bastante divertido: el heredero que parece tenerlo todo ni siquiera está acostumbrado a viajar en transporte público. 😂 Pero entre bromas y pequeñas sonrisas llega una pregunta mucho más importante. Si su automóvil viene siguiéndolos… ¿por qué Hyuk decidió quedarse en el autobús? Su respuesta sorprende a Min-ji: «Quería acompañarte.» ❤️ Por primera vez, las barreras entre ellos empiezan a bajar. Min-ji se permite sonreír, bromear e incluso reír genuinamente con él. Pero cuando llegan al humilde barrio donde vive Min-ji, algo cambia. Hyuk quiere continuar acompañándola, pero ella se detiene: «No. Desde aquí estoy bien.» Hyuk respeta su decisión y la deja marcharse sola. Lo que él no alcanza a ver es que, segundos después, Min-ji revisa su teléfono… y la sonrisa que llevaba en el rostro desaparece por completo. ¿Qué vio Min-ji? ¿Qué parte de su vida todavía está intentando más  lejos de Hyuk?  #kdramas kdrama #DramaCoreano #kdramaromance #seriecoreana #kdramafans

d: 🕯️ 10 เรื่องลึกของ “ถ้ำเสรีไทย ภูพาน” ถ้ำที่ไม่ได้ซ่อนแค่ความมืด… แต่เคยซ่อนชะตาของประเทศ ━ 1️⃣ ที่นี่ไม่ใช่ถ้ำธรรมดา ถ้ำเสรีไทยคือร่องรอยของขบวนการใต้ดินช่วงสงครามโลกครั้งที่ 2 พื้นที่ภูพานเคยถูกใช้เป็นฉากหลังของการเคลื่อนไหวลับ ที่ต้องอาศัยทั้งป่า ภูเขา และความไว้ใจของคนในพื้นที่ ━ 2️⃣ ทำไมต้องเป็น “ภูพาน” เพราะภูพานไม่ใช่แค่ภูเขา แต่เป็นแนวป่าที่ซับซ้อน มีทางเดินธรรมชาติ มีจุดหลบสายตา เหมาะกับการซ่อนคน ซ่อนของ และเคลื่อนกำลังโดยไม่ให้ถูกจับตา ━ 3️⃣ ถ้ำนี้เคยเกี่ยวกับอาวุธและเสบียง เรื่องเล่าทางประวัติศาสตร์ระบุว่า ถ้ำเสรีไทยเคยเป็นจุดสะสมอาวุธยุทธภัณฑ์และเสบียง ไม่ใช่เพื่อสร้างสงคราม แต่เพื่อเตรียมรับมือในวันที่ประเทศอาจไม่มีทางเลือก ━ 4️⃣ เส้นทางรอบถ้ำไม่ใช่ทางเดินเล่นธรรมดา เส้นทางธรรมชาติรอบถ้ำยาวประมาณ 5 กิโลเมตร ผ่านป่าเต็งรัง ป่าเบญจพรรณ จุดชมพระอาทิตย์ และทุ่งกระเจียว แต่มองอีกมุม นี่อาจเคยเป็น “เส้นเลือดลับ” ของการลำเลียงข่าวและเสบียง ━ 5️⃣ ชื่อ “ขุนพลภูพาน” ไม่ได้มาเพราะบังเอิญ เตียง ศิริขันธ์ คือหนึ่งในแกนสำคัญของเสรีไทยสายอีสาน เขาไม่ได้เป็นแค่คนในประวัติศาสตร์ แต่เป็นภาพแทนของเครือข่ายคนธรรมดาที่เลือกยืนอยู่ข้างเอกราช ━ 6️⃣ รหัสลับ “พลูโต” ในโลกของปฏิบัติการใต้ดิน ชื่อจริงอาจอันตรายเกินไป รหัสลับจึงไม่ใช่แค่ชื่อเรียก แต่มันคือเกราะป้องกันชีวิตของทั้งคนส่งข่าว คนรับข่าว และคนร่วมขบวน ━ 7️⃣ คนในพื้นที่คือกำลังสำคัญ เสรีไทยไม่ได้ขับเคลื่อนด้วยผู้นำเพียงคนเดียว แต่ต้องพึ่งชาวบ้าน ครู กำนัน ผู้ใหญ่บ้าน และคนธรรมดาที่รู้เส้นทางป่า เพราะในภูมิประเทศแบบนี้ คนรู้พื้นที่คือกุญแจของทุกภารกิจ ━ 8️⃣ ความลี้ลับของถ้ำ อาจเกิดจากความทรงจำ บางคนเล่าถึงบรรยากาศเหมือนมีคนเดิน แสงตะเกียงลึกในป่า หรือความรู้สึกเหมือนพื้นที่นี้ยังไม่เคยว่างเปล่า บางทีสิ่งที่เรากลัว… อาจไม่ใช่ผี แต่อาจเป็น “เสียงสะท้อนของประวัติศาสตร์” ━ 9️⃣ ถ้ำที่เงียบที่สุด อาจเคยดังที่สุด ในวันที่สงครามยังไม่จบ ทุกเสียงกิ่งไม้หัก ทุกแสงไฟ และทุกฝีเท้า อาจหมายถึงชีวิตของคนทั้งเครือข่าย ━ 🔟 วันนี้ถ้ำเสรีไทยคือบทเรียน มันเตือนเราว่า เอกราชไม่ได้เกิดจากคำประกาศสวยงาม แต่เกิดจากคนจำนวนมากที่ทำงานในเงามืด โดยหวังเพียงให้ประเทศยังเป็นของคนไทย ━ ทุกตำนาน… มักมีความจริงซ่อนอยู่เสมอ #โคตรลี้ลับ #บันทึกลับ #ความลึกลับ #ประวัติศาสตร์ลับ #ปริศนาโลก #ถ้ำเสรีไทย #ภูพาน #สกลนคร #เสรีไทย #ขุนพลภูพาน #ประวัติศาสตร์ไทย #สงครามโลกครั้งที่2

d: Pray for Thai students surviving Thai class at school 😂  Just a little note before anyone gets confused 🇹🇭 Thai words in this video are not commonly used in everyday conversation. (You can remember only the word “phrá•aa•thít” = sun (common used) but most of Thai words in this video, They are mostly found in Thai poetry, literature, traditional writing, and sometimes in song lyrics. These are examples of คำไวพจน์ (kham wai-phót) different words that can have the same or very similar meanings, often used to make writing sound more beautiful, expressive, or poetic Thai students actually learn these in Thai language class at school, especially when studying literature, poetry, and composition. So if you’re learning Thai as a foreigner, Don’t worry, you definitely don’t need to use all of these words in daily conversations 🇹🇭 This video is just a fun comparison between: What foreigners learn in Thai class 🇹🇭 VS What Thai students actually learn in Thai class 🇹🇭 And yes… Thai people study Thai too. 😂 #learnthai #speakthai #thaiwithfah #learnthailanguage #thailanguage

d: Try this mouthwatering Mutton pulao and thank me later 😌 Ingredients: 5 tbsp oil Mutton, cut into 1–1½ inch pieces 2 tbsp tomato purée 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste 2 tomatoes 1 fried onion 5–6 cloves 2 bay leaves 2 cinnamon sticks ½ tbsp whole black pepper 2 black cardamoms 2½ glasses water 2 garlic bulbs 4–5 dried red chillies 1 tbsp black pepper powder 1 tbsp cumin powder 1 tbsp coriander powder 1 tbsp salt 1 glass soaked rice Method of Preparation: Heat oil in a pot, add mutton and fry until lightly golden. Add tomato purée and sauté. Add ginger-garlic paste, chopped tomatoes and fried onion. Mix, cover and cook on low flame for 5 minutes. Add cloves, bay leaves, cinnamon, whole black pepper and black cardamom. Mix well. Transfer to a pressure cooker. Add water, garlic bulbs, dried red chillies, black pepper powder, cumin powder, coriander powder and salt. Close the lid and cook for 10 minutes after the first whistle. Allow the pressure to release naturally. Add the soaked rice, close the lid and cook on very low flame for 6–8 minutes. Turn off the heat, let it rest for a few minutes, then open the lid and allow the steam to escape. Transfer to a serving plate and enjoy with raita! #fyp #viral #mutton #pulao #rice

d: 📌Save this for later! One of those Indonesian meals I can never say no to🤤 Ayam penyet, warm rice, and sambal ijo Simple, messy, and SO good🤌🏽 1 kg chicken thighs (4 pieces) Spice blend: 5 garlic cloves 15 g ginger 7g turmeric 1 lemongrass 1 tsp coriander powder 1 tbsp salt 1 tsp mushroom bouillon 1/2 tsp white pepper Sambal: 125g green chilies 15 green bird's eye chilies 4 garlic cloves 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp mushroom bouillon A slice of lime 80 ml hot oil Instructions: 1. Blend the spice paste. Mix it with the chicken and the rest of the marinade, then marinate in the fridge for 2 to 3 hours. 2. Fry the chicken over medium heat until golden and cooked through. Then turn the heat to high until golden brown and crispy. 3. Fry the green chilies, bird's eye chilies, and garlic over medium heat for 1 minute. 1. Grind them and season with the salt, mushroom bouillon, and lime. 1. Pour the 80 ml hot oil over the sambal. Serve with the chicken.

d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

d: Martabak Manis: Cheesy and chocolatey Indonesian street pancake! RECIPE⬇️⬇️ Translated from DapurHasika on YouTube. Check her out for a video guide INGREDIENTS: 340 g all purpose flour 6 tbsp granulated sugar, or to taste 1/2 tsp salt 460 ml water 2 eggs 1/4 tsp vanilla extract  1 tsp baking soda 1 tsp baking powder Cheese, condensed milk, chocolate sprinkles, or any topping you like! A VERY nonstick pan METHOD: -in a bowl, mix the flour, sugar, and salt, until combined.  -Add water, and using an electric mixer (or a whisk), beat until combined into a thick but liquidy batter. Lumps are fine.  -Add the eggs, and beat. You want to strengthen the gluten and incorporate air, so beat for at least 5 minutes, I did 7 minutes with my mixer but more like 10 minutes with a whisk.  -It should now be completely smooth and increased in size -Whisk in vanilla, the baking soda, and powder. Beat again for 30 seconds and scrape the sides of the bowl to ensure it’s evenly distributed  -Get a VERY nonstick pan, rub a small amount of oil on the pan and wipe with a dry paper towel, to create an invisible film of oil -You can divide your batter into 3 even parts for an 8 inch. nonstick, or two parts for a 9-10 inch. Thinner pancake will not have a honeycomb.  -Heat over high heat. Splash some water on the pan. If it bounces and rolls on the surface, it’s ready for the batter. If it sputters and boils instantly, it’s not hot enough.  -pour the measured batter into the pan. Immediately rotate the pan to thinly coat the sides, about 1cm above the batter. -Return to the flame and turn the heat to medium.  -After about 1-2 minutes you should see many wet bubbles appearing on the top. At this point, you can choose to GENTLY sprinkle some sugar on the top, not too much as it can weight down the wet batter, and cover with a lid. Sugar is definitely not necessary. Then turn the heat to medium low.  -Throughout the process, monitor your pancake by smell and by looking at the thin layer to gauge what the bottom looks like. You can gently peek at the bottom of the pancake to see if it’s burning. After about 5-6 minutes, if the top looks dry, it’s ready.  -Carefully remove form the pan and add toppings -Enjoy! Tips:  Don’t be discouraged if the first pancake doesn’t work out. Use it as an opportunity to see what is going wrong. The heat needs to be hot at the beginning to encourage the formation of the honeycomb and the dry and crunchy crust. I think you want to have the heat as high as you can without burning the pancake for this recipe—cooking low and slow prevents the dramatic honeycomb. Similarly, the timing for making these will be different for everyone’s stove and pan size. So go by appearance and smell to see if it’s ready. #martabakmanis #dessert #indonesia #internationalfood

d: 🥩 DAGING SAPI MALBI KHAS PALEMBANG! DAGING SAPI EMPUK DENGAN BUMBU REMPAH 🇮🇩🤎 | 다깅 사삐 말비! 향신료 풍미 가득한 인도네시아식 소고기 조림 🇮🇩🤎 🥩 Hari ini aku membuat Daging Sapi Malbi, masakan khas Palembang, Sumatera Selatan, Indonesia! Daging sapi dimasak dengan kecap manis dan berbagai rempah seperti pala, cengkeh, dan kayu manis hingga bumbunya meresap sempurna🤎 Dagingnya empuk banget, dengan perpaduan rasa manis, gurih, dan aroma rempah yang khas. Kuahnya juga kaya rasa, sedikit kental, dan cocok banget dimakan bersama nasi putih hangat! Aku suka banget bagaimana rasa kecap manis berpadu dengan rempah-rempahnya. Rasanya berbeda dari masakan daging sapi Korea, tetapi justru itu yang membuatnya semakin menarik! Satu lagi masakan Indonesia yang berhasil bikin aku jatuh cinta!😊🩷 🥩 오늘은 인도네시아 남수마트라 팔렘방 지역의 전통 소고기 요리, 다깅 사삐 말비(Daging Sapi Malbi)를 만들어봤어요! 소고기에 케찹 마니스와 육두구, 정향, 계피 등 다양한 향신료를 넣고 양념이 깊게 배어들도록 푹 조리했습니다🤎 부드럽게 익은 소고기에 달콤짭짤한 양념과 향신료의 풍미가 어우러져 정말 매력적이었어요. 특히 진하고 살짝 걸쭉한 소스가 따뜻한 흰밥이랑 너무 잘 어울리더라고요! 한국식 소고기 장조림이나 갈비찜과 비슷한 듯하면서도 향신료 덕분에 완전히 다른 매력이 있었어요. 케찹 마니스 특유의 달콤한 감칠맛도 정말 좋았습니다! 이번에도 인도네시아 음식의 새로운 매력을 발견한 것 같아요. 정말 맛있게 잘 먹었습니다😊🩷 📧: bora97086@gmail.com YouTube: Rarari vlog TikTok: rararivlog Instagram: rararivlog #DagingSapiMalbi #MalbiPalembang #MasakanIndonesia #다깅사삐말비 #IndonesianFood

我が家の唐揚げレシピ🍖#唐揚げ  ■唐揚げ ○材料 ・鶏もも肉…1kg A醤油…大さじ4~5(ソースの有無によって調整) A酒…大さじ5 A生姜(皮付き)…1/4個 Aニンニク…2~3個 ・ごま油…大さじ2 ・地瓜粉…250〜300g １、鳥もも肉を一口サイズにカットします ２、大きなボウルに入れ、Aを加えて揉み込みます ３、ごま油を加えて表面をコーティングし、冷蔵庫で1時間寝かせます(できれば一晩) ４、ボウルに地瓜粉を入れ、鶏肉をコーティングします ５、衣をつけたら冷蔵庫で10〜15分休ませ、薄衣を作ります ６、180℃の油で4~5分揚げます(衣にしっかり色がついたらOK) ○ガーリックマヨソース ・マヨネーズ…120g ・牛乳…10g ・にんにくチューブ…5g ・レモン汁…3g ・はちみつ…5g ・ブラックペッパー…適量 ・塩…ひとつまみ ボウルに材料を全て入れ、混ぜて完成！

d: Cajun butter steak bites over parmesan mashed potatoes🥩🧈 recipe below: Cajun butter🧈 -4 tbsp unsalted softened butter  -1/2 tsp seasoned Cajun -1 tsp parsley -2 tsp minced garlic  -1 tsp lemon juice -1/2 tsp Dijon mustard  Mix until combined (optional: add red pepper flakes for spice) Cajun steak bites🥩 -trim 2 steaks of choice into 1 inch pieces -season with 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 1 tsp buttery steakhouse seasoning -let steaks rest before cooking to avoid chewy steak bites ** -cook in avocado oil on med/high heat -flip after 1-2 minutes  -reduce heat and stir in 2 tbsp Cajun butter -toss steak bites 1 additional minute  -remove steak and add asparagus  -season asparagus with lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, pepper, & Parmesan  creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes🥔 -peel 2 large gold potatoes  -dice into 1 inch cubes  -boil in salted water -drain water and mash -stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp sour cream, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, 1/2 tbsp butter, salt, pepper, & garlic powder  Assembly✨ -Add creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes to a bowl and top with Cajun butter steak bites🥩 Serve with asparagus, ciabatta, & garnish with parsley  #cooking #foodtiktok #fyp  #creatorsearchinsights #whatdoimakefordinner

d: ✨ แจกสูตรต้มผู้กอง หรือต้มหมูสับผักกาดดองกระป๋อง วัตถุดิบน้อย ทำง่าย รสชาติแซ่บสะใจ ไปลงมือทำกันเลยจ้า **ส่วนผสม** หมูบด 700 กรัม น้ำปลา 1 ช้อนโต๊ะ (หมักหมู) น้ำตาลทราย 1 ช้อนชา (หมักหมู) พริกไทยป่น 1/2 ช้อนชา ผักกาดดอง 2 กระป๋อง น้ำผักกาดดอง 4 ช้อนโต๊ะ (เพิ่มจากในคลิป) กระเทียมสับหยาบ 2 ช้อนโต๊ะพูนๆ พริกขี้หนูสวนบุบ 3 ช้อนโต๊ะ น้ำเปล่า 1500 ml. น้ำปลา 2 +1/2 ช้อนโต๊ะ น้ำมะนาว 3 ช้อนโต๊ะ ผักชีซอย 2 ช้อนโต๊ะ  วิธีทำ  1. หมักหมูบดกับน้ำปลา 1 ช้อนโต๊ะ น้ำตาลทราย  1 ช้อนชา  พริกไทยป่น 1/2 ช้อนชา นวดให้เข้ากันดี 2. ผักกาดดองกระป๋อง เทแยกน้ำแยกเนื้อ หั่นเนื้อผักกาดดองเป็นชิ้นพอคำ  3. ตั้งหม้อใส่น้ำเปล่าลงไป 1500 ml. ใช้ไฟกลางค่อนแรงต้มจนเดือด จากนั้นก็ปั้นหมูเป็นก้อนๆใส่ลงไป รอจนหมูสุก น้ำเดือดพล่าน หากมีฟองก็ช้อนทิ้งให้หมด ใส่ผักกาดดองทั้งหมด พร้อมน้ำดอง 4 ช้อนโต๊ะ  ต้มจนเดือดกลับมาอีกครั้ง ก็ปรุงรสด้วยน้ำปลา ตามด้วยกระเทียมสับหยาบ ปล่อยให้เดือดซักครู่ก็ปิดแก๊ส ใส่น้ำมะนาวลงไป ตามด้วยพริกขี้หนูสวนบุบ และผักชีซอย คนให้เข้ากัน ชิมรส หากขาดรสชาติไหนไปสามารถปรุงเพิ่มได้ตามชอบ  4. ตักใส่ชามเสิร์ฟร้อนๆ อร่อยมาก  #ต้มผู้ก#ต้มผู้กองส#ต้มหมูสับผักกาดดอง้#แม่ซีน้องมดดี้channel

d: ✨ กล้วยทอดซอสกล้วยบวชชี เมนูที่กำลังเป็นไวรัล สูตรแป้งทอดทำง่าย กรอบหอมอร่อย ไม่แข็ง ซอสกล้วยบวชชีก็หวานมัน อร่อยลงตัวสุดๆ ไปลงมือทำกันเลยจ้า **อัตราส่วน** แป้งทอดกล้วย 500 กรัม (แม่ซีใช้ตราอัมรินทร์ทิพย์) งาขาวดิบ 90 กรัม ผงฟู 1 ชช. เกลือป่น 1/2 ชต. น้ำตาลทรายไม่ฟอกสี 70 กรัม น้ำเย็นจัด 250 กรัม กะทิ 300 กรัม กากมะพร้าวขูด 150 กรัม (นน.หลังจากคั้นน้ำกะทิออกแล้ว) กล้วยน้ำว้าสุกห่าม 2-3 หวี ใบเตยหั่นท่อน ** อัตราส่วนซอสกล้วยบวชชี** กล้วยน้ำว้าสุกดี 2 ลูก น้ำตาลทราย 80 กรัม เกลือป่น 1/2 ชช. แป้งกวนไส้ 1 ชต. (ใช้แป้งข้าวโพด หรือแป้งข้าวเจ้าแทนได้) หัวกะทิ 500 กรัม เนยสดเค็ม 50 กรัม #กล้วยทอด #กล้วยทอดซอสกล้วยบวชชี #เมนูสร้างอาชีพ #แม่ซีน้องมดดี้channel

d: 🇵🇭 Chicken Sotanghon | Soups so good it can cure any sickness Ep. 32 Chicken Sotanghon is one of those Filipino comfort food that just hits, especially when you want something bolder other than your usual chicken noodle soup. My take is very garlic forward with a collagen rich broth  *Most measurements are estimates. Season and adjust to your liking :)* INGREDIENTS: Chicken & Broth: - 1 whole chicken, portioned - water or chicken stock, as needed (chicken stock just makes it extra rich and chickeny) - bay leaf - Salt and ground black pepper, to taste Soup: - Annatto oil for frying - 10-15 cloves garlic, minced - 1 red onion, chopped - 1/2 cup celery, chopped - shredded chicken - Reserved chicken broth as needed - Fish sauce to taste - Black pepper to taste - Annatto seeds (atsuete), for coloring  - sotanghon noodles (vermicelli noodles) - 1 large carrot, julienned - 1 Chinese cabbage, chopped - Quail eggs as needed, boiled and peeled  Toppings: - Spring onions - Crispy garlic bits INSTRUCTIONS: - Portion the chicken and place it in a pot with bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Pour in the chicken stock and water, then simmer for around 40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Remove the chicken and reserve the broth. Once cool enough to handle, remove the bones and shred the meat. - Heat the annatto oil, then lightly toast the minced garlic. Add the onion and chopped celery. Stir in the shredded chicken and pour in the reserved broth. Season with fish sauce and black pepper. - Place the annatto seeds in a fine-mesh strainer and dip them into the simmering soup, stirring gently until the broth turns a vibrant reddish-orange. Remove the seeds. - Add the sotanghon noodles and cook until they begin to soften. Follow with shredded Chinese cabbage, julienned carrots, and boiled quail eggs. Simmer until the vegetables and noodles are cooked through. - Ladle into a bowl, finish with chopped spring onions and crispy garlic.Serve hot and enjoy! #ASMR #CookingASMR #Soup #Soupsogood

Trying Filipino food as someone who’s barely had any 🇵🇭🫶 I’m on a mission to try more cuisines, as experiencing different cultures through their food is such a fun way to learn more about them! I previously checked out Ching's Famous Hopia, and this time I ordered Filipino food through Instagram from @lumpiajoy in Otay Ranch I got the $20 Combo Special which included a hefty portion of pancit + 5 pieces of lumpia (includes your choice of beef, chicken, pork, or veggie) + sweet chili sauce & vinegar dipping sauce My thoughts? The Pork Lumpia was divine. The meat is cooked before being wrapped, making the inside incredibly juicy while the outside stays nice and crispy. The sweet chili sauce AND vinegar dipping sauce were phenomenal! They also included some bonus Cheese Lumpia for free (so nice of them!) and they were SO good! I wanted 20 more! As for the pancit, this is a traditional Filipino noodle dish that's stir-fried with a savory sauce and veggies. This version has both thin & thicker noodles and Chinese sausage, which isn’t the most typical combination, but I loved the chewy noodles and Chinese sausage is soooo good!  Everything was phenomenal and I love getting to try something new while supporting local food businesses. 🫶 📍 Lumpia Joy | Otay Ranch, Chula Vista You can DM them on Instagram to get their menu and schedule a pickup! Crispy Air Fried Pork Belly Lechon 🇵🇭🔥 w/ a Sweet & Spicy Bagoong Dipping Sauce! All this goodness in just 2hrs tops! 🤯 I made this for all my guests on football Sunday, and let me tell you, it was straight up SMACKIN! I’m literally drooling just thinking about it as I type this caption. 😂 If you’ve been following me for a few years, you already know I’ve made crispy pork belly just about every way imaginable. Some methods I’ve done multiple times just to perfect them. I love the challenge, and you already know how much I love that smoke flavor! But I’ve seen many making crispy pork belly in the air fryer, so I figured it was time to give it a shot with my own spin on it. And I gotta tell you, they weren’t lying about how easy and delicious this method is! I did mine a little differently, cooking it at a lower temperature for a longer period to really render down that fat. That was THE MOVE! Perfectly rendered fat, juicy and tender meat, and that ridiculously crispy, crunchy skin! 💯 Now pair all that with a Sweet & Spicy Bagoong Dipping Sauce, made with Filipino fermented shrimp paste, and you’ve got an absolute UMAMI BOMB that’ll blow your socks off! 🤯 One MONEY AF recipe right here! 💯💰🔥 Marinade Paste: • 1 tbsp garlic paste • 1 tbsp lemon grass paste • 1/4 cup vinegar  • 1 tbsp soy sauce • 1 tbsp onion powder • 1 tbsp @Bear & Burton's W-Sauce Dipping Sauce: • 2-3 tbsp Bagoong (found at Asian or Filipino markets) • 1/4 cup cane vinegar or white • 1 tbsp @Melinda's Hot Sauce Sriracha • 1 tbsp @melindasfoods Hot Honey • 1-2 tbsp crispy fried garlic Instructions: 1. Poke holes on the skin side using a meat tenderizer. 2. Score meat side then apply marinade paste. Massage into the meat.  3. Place pork on foil and create a boat. Brush on white vinegar then apply a heavy coat of kosher salt evenly.  4. Into the @Ninja Kitchen air fryer at 300F for 1-1.5 hrs.  (I cooked it until the fat was rendered how I like it) 5. Remove salt then brush avocado oil then back into the air fryer at 400F for 30 min until the skin is completely crispy. Check periodically after the 1st 10 min to make sure it’s not burning.

My daughter had ONE request for her birthday lunch… Dad’s Chicken Adobo. ❤️🇵🇭 And what kind of father would I be if I told my little princess no? 😂 So Daddy got to work. Adobo-marinated grilled chicken thighs, potatoes, onions and hard-boiled eggs in that savory adobo broth, all served over rice with lumpia on the side. Packed everything up and brought it to her school so she could share one of her favorite meals with her classmates and teachers. As much as I love cooking for y’all and creating recipes, nothing beats cooking for my family, especially when my kids specifically asks for something Daddy makes. These are the moments that matter most. ❤️ Happy Birthday to my beautiful little princess. Daddy loves you more than you’ll ever know. And fellas… learn how to cook. Your kids might put you to work one day. 😂💪🏽 Marinade: • 1c cane vinegar or white • 1c soy sauce • 1 tbsp garlic powder  • 1 tbsp onion powder  • 1 tbsp coarse black pepper  Adobo: • 18-20 Boneless chicken thighs (whole Costco pack) • Dozen hard boiled eggs • 2c cane vinegar or white • 2c soy sauce  • 2c water • 1 whole white onion  • 6 russet potatoes • 10 cloves garlic  • 1 tbsp whole peppercorns • 2 tbsp white miso • 2 bay leaves Instructions: 1. Added chicken to my @DRIP EZ Prep Tub, added all marinade ingredients in, mixed and let marinate for 1hr.  2. Add all adobo ingredients into a large pot except chicken and eggs. Bring to a boil then simmer for 1hr until potatoes are fork tender.  3. Grill your chicken thighs until an internal temp of around 150F.  4. Place chicken and hard boiled eggs into broth then let simmer for 30-45min.  5. Once done let cool for 30mins then serve with rice, lumpia and garnish with crispy fried garlic. d: 🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

d: Nilagang Baka (Filipino Beef and Vegetable Soup) A cozy, comforting soup of tender beef ribs simmered in a savory broth with hearty vegetables. Best enjoyed with steamed rice and a bit of fish sauce on the side. Ingredients * 4 lbs beef ribs, cut into single pieces * 1 large onion, halved * 1 Tbsp garlic powder * 1 Tbsp black pepper * 1 Tbsp kosher salt * 2–3 beef bouillon cubes * 8 cups water * 2–3 bay leaves * 2–3 ears yellow corn, cut into thirds * 2 russet potatoes, cut into large chunks * 1 bunch bok choy, cleaned and trimmed * 2 Tbsp fish sauce (or to taste) Instructions 1. Cook the Beef: In a pressure cooker or Instant Pot, combine beef ribs, onion, garlic powder, bouillon cubes, pepper, bay leaves, and water. Pressure cook on high for 15 minutes, then let it naturally release for another 15 minutes before opening the lid. No pressure cooker? Simmer on the stovetop for 2–3 hours until ribs are fork-tender. Add water if the broth reduces too much or becomes too salty. 2. Cook the Vegetables: While the beef is cooking, boil potatoes in salted water until fork-tender (15–18 minutes). Add corn and simmer for another 5 minutes. Blanch bok choy for 1 minute and set aside. 3. Adjust the Broth: Once the beef is done, taste the broth. Adjust with more bouillon, salt, or fish sauce as needed. 4. Assemble and Serve: Add the cooked vegetables to the beef broth. Serve hot with steamed white rice and extra fish sauce on the side if desired. Enjoy! #nilagangbaka #bulalo #beefsoup #filipino #filipinofood #easyrecipe #easy #recipe #food #foodies #foodlover #dinner #lunch #dinnerideas #lunchideas

d: In honor of Filipino American History Month 🇵🇭 proof that eating high protein doesn’t mean eating boring food 🤭 filipino food edition because I refuse to sacrifice flavor for my fitness goals!! on this week’s menu: 🍗 chicken adobo 🥩 beef giniling 🥬 beef lumpia recipes ↓ 🍗 CHICKEN ADOBO 4 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs ¾ cup soy sauce ¾ cup vinegar 1–1½ cups water 1–2 tbsp brown sugar 8–10 cloves garlic, minced 3–4 bay leaves 1 tsp black pepper 1 onion, sliced marinate chicken in soy sauce, garlic + black pepper for at least 30 min. remove chicken & save the marinade. sear chicken on both sides, then remove from the pan. sauté onion + garlic, pour in the reserved marinade, vinegar, water, brown sugar + bay leaves. bring to a boil, add chicken back in & simmer covered for ~20 min. uncover and simmer another 10–15 min until the sauce reduces 🤌🏼 🥩 BEEF GINILING 2 lb lean ground beef 2 potatoes, diced 2 carrots, diced 1 onion, diced 4–5 cloves garlic 1 red bell pepper, diced 8 oz tomato sauce 2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp fish sauce ½ cup water or beef broth black pepper brown the beef, then add onion + garlic. stir in soy sauce, fish sauce + pepper. add potatoes, carrots, tomato sauce + broth. cover & simmer 12–15 min until the veggies soften. add bell pepper near the end, then uncover and cook another 5–10 min until the sauce thickens. 🥬 BEEF LUMPIA 1 lb lean ground beef 1 bag pre-packaged coleslaw mix ½ onion, finely diced 3–4 cloves garlic, minced soy sauce garlic powder  onion powder black pepper lumpia wrappers Mae Ploy sweet chili sauce  brown the beef with onion + garlic, then add the coleslaw mix and cook until just softened. season to taste with soy sauce + black pepper and let the filling cool. add a small amount to each wrapper, roll tightly + seal the edge with water. fry until golden + crispy or air fry at 375°F for ~10–12 min, flipping halfway. Serve with Mae Ploy sweet chili sauce  serve everything with jasmine rice + your favorite veggies who said hitting your protein goals had to mean chicken, rice & broccoli every week?? Save this for your next meal prep 🇵🇭  #filipinofood #highproteinmeals #mealprep #filipinorecipes

d: Episode 5: Homemade Garlic Longganisa 🇵🇭 (Pinoy-Style) Ingredients:  900 g ground pork 150 g pork fat (optional) 20 cloves garlic, finely minced 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp white vinegar 1 tsp paprika 2 tbsp cornstarch 1 tbsp salt 1 tbsp black pepper Natural hog casing  Kitchen twine Procedure:  1. Rinse and soak the hog casing in water for 1 minute. Drain well. 2. Mix the ground pork, garlic, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper, paprika, cornstarch, and cold water until sticky and well combined. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours 3. Stuff the mixture into the casing, being careful not to overfill. Twist and tie with kitchen twine. 4. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight to slightly dry the casing. Then freeze overnight. 4. To cook, place the longganisa in a pan with ¼ cup water. Cover and cook over medium heat until the water evaporates. Add 1–2 tbsp oil and fry until golden brown and cooked through, reaching 71°C / 160°F internally. You can add any seasoning but make sure you mix it well with the meat! Pwede adobo flavor or any. Enjoy my recipe and tag me pag nakagawa na kayo! ☺️ #ChefYlyt #privatechef #easyrecipes #homemade #longganisa

d: Ginataang Manok  Ingredients: 4 Chicken thighs and 4-6 drumsticks Kosher salt for seasoning the chicken 1/2 onion, sliced 3 cloves garlic, minced 3/4 Cup water 2 Cans coconut milk 1 Anaheim Pepper 3 Fresno chillies (optional) use 1-2 Thai chili if you like it spicy 1 Chicken Bouillon Cube 1 Tbsp Black pepper 1 Tbsp Fish sauce 40g Ginger, cut in slices 1 Large potato 1 Large Carrot Bok Choy Instructions 1. Season the chicken generously with kosher salt. For the best flavor, refrigerate and let it season overnight. 2. Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken skin-side down until golden brown and the fat has rendered, about 5–7 minutes. Flip and cook for 1 more minute, then remove from the pot. 3. In the same pot, sauté the onions for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Pour in the water and coconut milk, then stir in the ginger, bouillon cube, fish sauce, and black pepper. Return the chicken to the pot. 5. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered over medium-low heat for 15 minutes. 6. Add the potatoes, carrots, and Fresno chilies (if using). Continue simmering for another 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are fork-tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Taste the broth and adjust the seasoning if needed. 8. Serve hot with steamed white rice. #ginataangmanok #filipino #recipe #food #easyrecipe

d: Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

d: Making Cajun Shrimp & Sausage pasta in my room! 🦐🤤 — I would make this everyday if I could. Pretty much a one pot meal! What should I make for Halloween? 👀  Order Lazy Pot on Amazon! Ingredients: * Cajun sausage * Medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails removed * Salt * Black pepper * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Cayenne pepper * Paprika * Red pepper flakes * Parmesan cheese * Heavy cream * Butter * Rigatoni or pasta of choice * Fresh parsley * Sliced baguette Instructions: * Season shrimp and sliced Cajun sausage with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne, paprika, and red pepper flakes. * Melt butter in a large pan and cook sausage until browned. Add shrimp and cook until pink and opaque. Remove both and set aside. * Boil pasta in salted water until al dente. Meanwhile, toast baguette slices in butter until golden and crispy. * In the same pan used for the shrimp and sausage, melt additional butter and pour in heavy cream. Stir over medium-low heat to create a smooth sauce. * Gradually add grated Parmesan cheese, stirring until melted and thickened. Add additional seasonings to taste. * Add cooked pasta and toss until evenly coated in the creamy Cajun sauce. Add a splash of pasta water if needed. * Return the cooked shrimp and sausage to the sauce, reserving a few pieces for plating. Mix well. * Plate the pasta and top with reserved shrimp and sausage. Finish with freshly chopped parsley for color. * Serve with toasted buttered baguette slices on the side for dipping into the sauce!  #food #pasta #easyrecipe #cooking #dinnerideas

d: Honey chipotle chicken wraps! 🌯 #Hungry #Lunch  What you need for the salad 🥗  2 red onions  2 Bell peppers 🫑  1 cucumber  1 Iceberg lettuce  Dice and put these in a bowl 🥣  For the chicken 🍗  2kg boneless chicken thighs, cut into small cubes  1 tsp Tandoori spice blend  1 tbsp Italian Aromat all purpose seasoning  1 tbsp smoked paprika 2 tbsp Dark soy sauce  1 tbsp chili powder 1 tsp garlic granules  2 red onion, diced Mix these up and leave for 30 minutes so it marinates, ideally should be 1hr30min for the best balance of flavour.  What you need for the Honey chipotle sauce 🥣 4 tbsp of fat free Greek yoghurt (my preference) or 8tbsp Mayonnaise  1/2 tbsp of honey 🍯  2 tbsp of ketchup  1 tbsp of peanut butter 🥜 (my preference) 1/2 tbsp of chilli powder  1 squeezed lemon juice 🍋 30g of Chopped flat free Parsley 🌿  Give these a mix!  How to cook! 👨🏾‍🍳🫕 Firstly, season your diced chicken and leave in the refrigerator for 30min so it marinates. ideally they should be left for 1hr30min for the best balance of flavour 🙂 While waiting it’s should be the best time to make the honey chipotle sauce. 🧠😉 (recipe above, pls go back if you’ve missed it 🙂) Dice all you need for your salad options and leave in a bowl 🥗🥣  Get your frying pan out, using olive oil, cook your chicken for 5-7 minutes per sides at 165°C–175°C When the chicken’s cooked add a little portion of your honey chipotle sauce and mix  For dressing your tortilla 🫓 Place on your tortilla, your creamed up diced chicken, salad, lettuce (to prevent your sauce from dripping), Mozzarella cheese and some sauce on top to go with.  Fold nicely and Toast on fire in a low heat to avoid your warp getting burnt.  Voilaaaa! You just made a honey chipotle chicken wrap 🌯😉

d: BBQ Dinner for my brother in-laws High school golf team | Save Recipes ⬇️ Smoked BBQ Pork Ribs Servings: Approximately 12–16 Cook time: Approximately 6–8 hours, depending on the ribs Smoker temperature: 225°F Ingredients 4 racks of pork ribs Traeger rub, to taste, for 2 racks Meat Church Gospel rub, to taste, for 2 racks (Alternative: Use a simple homemade rub with brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.) BBQ sauce, optional, for serving Instructions Pat the ribs dry. If the membrane has not been removed, make sure to do this before you season. Season 2 racks generously with Traeger rub and the other 2 racks with Meat Church Gospel rub. No binder is needed. Preheat the Traeger to 225°F. Place the ribs on the smoker around 9 a.m. Smoke throughout the day, maintaining a temperature of 225°F. Continue cooking until the ribs are very tender and nearly falling off the bone, generally around 200–205°F internally. Check tenderness with a probe, as temperature alone doesn’t guarantee they’re ready. Remove the ribs from the smoker and let them rest for approximately 30 mins, keeping them covered and warm. Slice between the bones and serve with BBQ sauce on the side, if desired. Note: If you don’t have a smoker, these can be done in the oven at the same temps! Just use a meat thermometer to check on the internal temperature. Smoked Pulled Pork Servings: Approximately 20–30 Cook time: Overnight, plus several hours the following day Ingredients 2 pork butts Fire & Smoke Society Sweet Preacher rub, to taste (Alternative: Use brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, and a little cayenne for heat.) BBQ sauce, optional, for serving Instructions Pat the pork butts dry. Apply Sweet Preacher rub generously on all sides. No binder is needed. Preheat the Traeger to 225°F. Place both pork butts on the smoker and smoke overnight. Continue smoking the following day until the pork reaches around 200–205°F internally and is tender enough to pull apart easily. If the pork is taking longer than desired, wrap each butt in foil or butcher paper to help speed up cooking. Once tender, remove the pork from the smoker and let it rest at least 1 hour, keeping it covered and warm. I used a cooler to keep it insulated. Pull the pork apart using forks or meat claws. Serve with BBQ sauce on the side, if desired. Note: If you don’t have a smoker, these can be done in the oven at the same temps! Just use a meat thermometer to check on the internal temperature. Baked Macaroni and Cheese Serves 10–12 Ingredients 1 (16-ounce) package elbow macaroni 2 cups whole milk 2 cups half and half ½ cup unsalted butter ½ cup all-purpose flour 3 (8-ounce) packages thick-shredded cheddar cheese (24 oz total, about 6 cups) ½ tablespoon salt (1½ teaspoons) ¼ teaspoon black pepper Instructions Cook the pasta just under al dente in salted water according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease one or two baking dishes, as needed. In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk, followed by the half and half. Cook for about 5 minutes, whisking constantly, until thickened. Add the salt and pepper. Stir in 2 cups of shredded cheddar until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and mix thoroughly. Transfer half the mixture to the prepared baking dish, sprinkle with 1 cup of cheese, then add the remaining macaroni mixture. Top with the remaining 3 cups of cheese. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 20–30 minutes, or until bubbly and the cheese on top begins to brown. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving. Notes Use a combination of mild and sharp cheddar for the best flavor. Taste the sauce before adding all the salt, since the cheese and salted pasta water contribute additional salt.

d: Crispy Steak Mac & Cheese 🥩🧀 Ingredients 1 lb cavatappi 16 oz mozzarella 12 oz Colby Jack 8 oz sharp cheddar 4 oz Fontina 3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour 12 oz evaporated milk 2 cups heavy cream 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder & smoked paprika 1 tsp chicken bouillon ½ tbsp Dijon Reserved pasta water 1 large ribeye or NY strip Salt, pepper & garlic powder 1 tbsp oil + 1 tbsp butter Directions 1. Cook pasta 1 min shy of al dente; reserve 1 cup pasta water. 2. Melt 3 tbsp butter, whisk in flour and cook 2 min. Slowly whisk in evaporated milk, then cream, seasonings, bouillon & Dijon. Simmer 3–5 min. 3.Turn heat LOW. Melt in 4 oz each Fontina, mozzarella, Colby Jack & cheddar (16 oz total). Save the remaining 24 oz cheese for layering. 4. Add pasta. If too thick, loosen with reserved pasta water until very creamy. 5. Add half the mac to a baking dish → 8 oz reserved cheese → remaining mac → remaining 16 oz cheese. 6. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 25–30 min, then broil 1–3 min until golden and crispy. 7. Season steak and sear in oil about 3–4 min per side. Add butter and baste. For medium-rare, pull around 125–128°F and rest 8–10 min. 8. Rest mac 5–10 min, slice steak and pile it on top.  #macandcheese #comfortfood #easyrecipe #steak #cooking

d: Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

d: Steak & Eggs, cooked entirely in a cast iron pan on my balcony. There’s something about a hot cast iron, a ribeye, crispy potatoes, and eggs that just feels right. Ingredients: * 1 ribeye steak * Salt & black pepper * 3 Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into large chunks * 1 onion, julienned * 3 eggs * 1 tbsp neutral oil Cowboy Butter: * 1 stick (½ cup) butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, minced * 2 tbsp chopped parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes * ½ tsp Cajun seasoning * ½ tsp cayenne pepper * Salt & black pepper, to taste Method: 1. Preheat a cast iron pan in a 500°F pizza oven (or any very hot oven). Add the neutral oil and sear the ribeye until medium-rare to medium. Remove and let it rest. 2. Add the onion and cook until deeply golden. Stir in the potatoes and roast until they’re tender with crispy edges. 3. Push the potatoes to the outside of the pan, leaving a circle in the center. Crack in the 3 eggs. 4. Slice the rested steak. Pour in the cowboy butter, add the steak back to the pan, and let everything sizzle until the eggs are cooked to your liking. 5. Serve immediately and spoon that cowboy butter over everything. #steakandeggs #easyrecipes #ribeye #torontofood

d: Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

d: Fridge Ramen Recipe: 8 cups of water 1/4 cup Gochujang (red pepper paste) 1/4 cup soy sauce 1/4 cup sugar or brown sugar  2 tablespoons garlic powder 1/2 large yellow onion, sliced 1 cup kimchi (optional) 1-2 tablespoons curry powder (optional) Add-ins this time: Brisket sausages  Red cabbage  Carrots Snap peas Green onions Boiled eggs Roasted sweet potato Asparagus  2 packs of ramen  Water as needed Black sesame seeds, for topping 3-4 cups of cheese for topping 🤭 Other add-ins I’ve done: Heavy cream Coconut milk  Soup dumplings Gyoza Green beans Yellow squash Tofu Zucchini  Roasted chicken Leftover Mac and cheese Marinated carrots Condensed milk (up to 3 tablespoons) Green Peas White potatoes  BBQ pork Velveeta  Black eyed peas Kambocha squash  Coleslaw mix Asparagus Shrimp Chili Imitation crab Bell peppers Country ham 1. In a large, shallow pot, combine the water, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, garlic powder, kimchi, and and curry powder (if using). Stir until the gochujang dissolves. Bring to a boil, then cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. 2. Arrange your add-ins in the pot, leaving out the ramen and cheese. Bring the broth back to a boil, cover, and cook for 10 minutes. 3. Add the ramen and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring frequently to keep the noodles from sticking and help them cook evenly. Add hot water if your broth evaporated too much. 	 4. Arrange the cheese on top, cover, and cook for another 5 minutes, or until the cheese melts into the broth. 	 5. Serve bubbling hot straight from the pot, with rice on the side, if desired. Inspired by kimchi jjigae and budae jjigae but this is NOT authentic at all 😊

d: CRAB RANGOON CRACK SQUARES 🦀🔥 The best crab rangoon I’ve ever had—and I made it. 😂 Crispy Spicy Sweet Chili Doritos outside, creamy cheesy crab inside. Holy freaking crap. Girl dinner perfection! Fried half, froze the rest, and delivered FIVE with sauce to my neighbor’s door on a platter. Somebody notify the HOA—I deserve an award. 😂 INGREDIENTS • 2 (8-ounce) blocks cream cheese, softened • 20 ounces imitation crab, finely chopped • 2 cups shredded mozzarella • 1 bunch green onions, sliced, including light green and a little white • 1 tablespoon powdered sugar • 2 teaspoons garlic powder • ½ teaspoon salt BREADING • 1 cup flour • 3 eggs, beaten • 3 cups crushed Doritos Spicy Sweet Chili chips • 1 cup plain panko • Frying oil • Sweet chili sauce for dipping Breading amounts are starting quantities; add more as needed. HOW TO 1. Mix filling ingredients. Press into an even layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze about 1 hour, until firm enough to cut. 2. Cut into roughly 2-by-2-inch squares. 3. Coat in flour, then egg, then combined Doritos and panko, pressing crumbs onto all sides. 4. Fry in hot oil in batches until golden and hot inside—mine took about 1½ minutes per side. 5. Drain on a wire rack and serve with sweet chili sauce. FREEZER STASH: Freeze extra breaded squares until firm, then bag with parchment between layers. #recipe #crabrangoon #dinner #food #easyrecipe

d: anthony bourdain understood something about mexico that i wish more people did 🇲🇽 some of the best food in the world isn’t served in a fancy restaurant. it’s served on a plastic plate, eaten standing on a sidewalk, and prepared by someone who’s spent decades perfecting their craft. mexican street food is so much more than a cheap meal.Bourdain famously said, “Mexican food is about or even come close to reproducing it. It is perhaps the most misunderstood country and cuisine on Earth. This is frankly a racist assumption that Mexican food or Indian food should be cheap.” it’s generations of recipes, traditions passed down through families, hours of preparation, and an incredible amount of pride in every single dish. one of the things i love most about living in mexico city is how much of the city’s culture you can experience simply by pulling up a stool at a neighborhood taquería. you don’t need reservations, a tasting menu, or a big budget to eat extraordinarily well here. you just need to know where to look. what’s the best taco you’ve ever had in mexico? 🌮 #mexicocity #cdmx #anthonybourdain #mexicanfood #streetfood mexicocityfood

d: Would you actually eat this street food? 😳 In this wild street food compilation, we explore some of the most unbelievable street food scenes from around the world. From massive woks full of noodles to busy street vendors cooking huge portions right in front of customers, this video shows the reality of street food markets and street food cooking that millions of people enjoy every day. Street food is famous for its bold flavors, fast cooking, and incredible variety. In many countries, street vendors prepare delicious meals in giant pans, sizzling grills, and steaming pots right on the street. But sometimes the cooking conditions can look a little questionable… which raises the big question — would you actually eat this street food? 🍜🔥 This street food video shows everything from huge noodle stir-fries and sizzling wok cooking to intense street kitchen action where vendors prepare food quickly for long lines of hungry customers. Street food markets are full of energy, heat, flames, and nonstop cooking that makes these food scenes fascinating to watch. Whether you love street food, enjoy food documentaries, or just want to see some unbelievable cooking moments, this street food compilation will definitely make you think twice. Some of these street food scenes look delicious… while others might make you wonder if you would really try it! 🤯 Let us know in the comments — would YOU eat this street food? 👇  #streetfood​ #shorts​ #food​

前十里9分剧只有3部，琅琊榜是2015年的，甄嬛传是2011年的，播了十几年，人数还在涨。
狂飙110万人打分，按一个潜规则换算，打分的人通常不到看过的十分之一，这部剧至少几千万人看过。
分数是一个人的评价，人数是一代人的脚印。

d:
每天八卦一小时竟是维系社交？📚原来我们对八卦的误解这么深
1️⃣先打破刻板印象：有研究给数百人佩戴随身录音设备统计，人平均每天要花五十多分钟谈论不在场的人。在学界定义里，八卦不单单指说人坏话，只要聊到不在场的人都算八卦。数据显示约四分之三的八卦既非好话也非坏话，只是单纯交换信息；年轻人更爱说负面八卦，女性也并不比男性更爱议论他人。
2️⃣八卦本质是人类的“梳毛社交”：观察四十多种灵长类动物，猩猩猴子靠互相梳毛维系彼此关系，梳毛时长和群体规模正相关，而非和体型相关。人类学家邓巴提出猜想，随着人类群体规模变大，靠肢体梳毛无法覆盖所有成员，就改用闲聊八卦的方式维系关系，甚至有假说认为语言演化的初衷就是为了议论他人。
3️⃣八卦的正向作用远超想象：邓巴团队1997年的街头观察显示，人们闲聊里约三分之二是社交话题，真正批评他人的内容占比很低；2024年的相关复核研究得出的比例更高，约为85%。斯坦福大学2014年的合作游戏实验证明，允许互相八卦的小组更能维持合作度，能通过八卦排挤自私成员的小组表现最优，被排挤过的人后续也会更配合团队。
当然八卦也存在伤人风险，恶意八卦和群体排斥很容易被滥用，下次开口前不妨先问问自己，聊这件事是为了交换信息提醒他人，还是单纯为了拆台。
八卦本质只是人类维系社交的方式而已，大家最近一次八卦聊的是谁？
#涨知识#社交冷知识#八卦
zh: 八卦是维系社交的方式：人日均聊不在场者50多分钟，多为中性信息，有助合作

每日一舞 | 古风燃脂美体舞《如愿》跟练 初听《如愿》只觉温柔，再跳《如愿》方懂深情。这支舞，跳的从来不是动作，是岁月，是传承，是无数先辈藏在时光里的期盼。我们生于盛世，长于春风，不曾亲历苦难，却能读懂山河无恙的来之不易。
抬手是仰望星河，俯身是拥抱人间，每一次舒展、每一次停顿，都藏着滚烫的心意。那些无人知晓的坚守，那些跨越岁月的等候，那些拼尽全力的奔赴，终在今朝圆满。
你是岁月长河，星火燃起的天空；我是仰望者，也是传承者。
以舞寄情，以姿致谢。愿所有颠沛流离皆有归途，所有默默付出皆有回响。我们终将活成你们期许的模样，不负岁月，不负盛世，不负每一份滚烫的热爱。
愿不枉，愿勇往，岁岁平安，盛世如常✨
#我的长长长假 #形体运动 #古风舞蹈 #如愿完整版 #节目表演
